 Six years ago, actor and humanitarian Gary Sinise stepped away from Hollywood to focus on his family and care for his son Mac, who was diagnosed with a rare bone cancer. Mac died in 2024 but his legacy lives on through his music and in Gary’s powerful new memoir “Graceful Warrior: The True Story of a Son, a Father, and a Family Who Carried Each Other Through.” “I needed to do it for myself and for my son and for my family, just write this down and share it. It’s really not a book about cancer, as it is as much a book about perseverance, determination and this amazing, graceful warrior that our son was through the whole thing. It was a tough fight but he was so inspirational and courageous through it,” he says. Nov. 10, 2026
